t.heroSub: We partner with founders who have the vision but need a technical lead to validate the idea, build the product and scale it. No development fees: we take equity and build alongside you.
t.howTitle: Three stages, one product, two founders.

steps.d: We test the idea, define the scope and build a roadmap to reach the market.
A dedicated full-stack team handles architecture, development and deployment.
After launch we gather feedback, ship improvements and help grow the team, including hiring key talent in-house.

t.parSub: We share the risk and the upside. That is why we choose projects carefully and ask for commitment in return.

we.d: Not a rotating bench of freelancers.
Architecture, backend, frontend, infrastructure and deployment.
Guidance on stack, scalability and trade-offs, taken on as an owner.
Support bringing key talent in-house when the time comes.

you.d: No development fees: our return is tied to the product.
Knowledge of the market, the users and the problem.
Commitment to quick decisions and clear priorities.
User feedback, metrics and customer conversations.
An idea with a real path to users and revenue.
